speaker: David Kaufer
quote: We've learned that what looks like a lack of understanding may actually be a motor planning challenge. We've also learned that what looks like a behavioral issue may be sensory overload. What appears to be an inability to communicate may simply be a person who hasn't been given the right way to communicate.

speaker: Denise Allen
quote: Exactly. And I remember as a child going in for my yearly exam, and I was about 10. And they did this test where you look in the big machine. And on one side, there's a note, and on the other side, there's the 5 lines for the music staff. And they said, can you tell us what line or space that note's on. And I said, well, I see the notes over here and I see the lines over here. Do you want me to guess?

speaker: Denise Allen
quote: And I just said, do you want me to guess? Because I can't—I, I see them on, you know, with each eye. And, and I had never been able to see through binoculars or, you know, the little kaleidoscope thing that—
